**Conflict resolved** — merged `origin/main` (f812de6bd) into the branch; merge commit c393262. No rebase, no force.

**One file conflicted:** `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`, at the home-grid app filter.

| Side | What it wanted |
|---|---|
| `main` (#4242 / objectui#4074) | Extract the predicate `active !== false && hidden !== true` into a shared `filterActiveApps()` in `utils/appRoute.ts`, so Home's launcher and every producer that builds a link into an app answer "an app the user can open" identically |
| this branch (objectstack#6955) | Add a ⛔ note to that same inline predicate: it keeps filtering `hidden` and must NEVER gain an `_unpublished` clause |

**What I kept: both.** Neither side is behavioral against the other, so this was not a trade-off. HomePage takes main's `filterActiveApps(apps)` call, and my ⛔ note moves onto `filterActiveApps` itself — a strictly stronger place for it, since that is now the single definition and it therefore also covers `resolveHostAppSegment`'s link producers, which main newly routed through the same predicate. I added the matching ⛔ case to `utils/__tests__/appRoute.test.ts`, next to main's new cases.

**The #6955 contract is unchanged by the merge:** `filterActiveApps` does not read `_unpublished`; the banner still reads `_unpublished`; the per-app publish body is still `{"_unpublished": false}`; all launcher surfaces still filter `hidden` alone. Reverse-verified by injecting the guarded clause into `filterActiveApps` — that case, and only that case, went red (`expected [ 'crm' ] to deeply equal [ 'crm', 'draft_app' ]`), then restored.

**Re-run post-merge, all green:**

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/  → Test Files 339 passed (339) | Tests 3218 passed | 1 skipped
pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/        → Test Files  33 passed  (33) | Tests  346 passed (346)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check  → Done
pnpm --filter @object-ui/console   type-check  → Done
```

(339/3218 vs. 334/3123 pre-merge — main's five new test files plus my added case.)

One stale detail in the PR body above, not worth an edit that would churn the armed PR: its contract table lists the home-grid pin at `HomePage.tsx:267`; after this merge that pin lives on `filterActiveApps` in `utils/appRoute.ts` and is test-pinned rather than comment-pinned. Every other row is unchanged.
